'''Hurrwarr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who worked as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] in the [[Cabana Bar]], the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] of the [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] [[Sanads of Rorkee]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Rorkee]], on [[Genarius]]. Locals tried to convince newcomers to play a supposed game called [[Stump-the-Wookiee-Bartender]].

Hurrwarr suffered from [[obsessive-compulsive disorder]]; he combed and cleaned his [[Hair/Legends|fur]]&mdash;even while working, took pains to keep things in the places he had chosen for them, and suffered whenever he saw a cup without its coaster. His excessive behavior took a toll among his clientele; more than a few disliked Hurrwarr's attitude and did not came back.

In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Hurrwarr attended Dr. [[Shilaea Motacc]], a guest of the hotel who went several times to the Bar to enjoy [[Double-Dip Outer Rim Rumdrop]]s. Soon after Motacc's apparent death, an unidentified customer went to the Bar during Hurrwarr's break, bought all the stock of Rim Rumdrops, paying in cash, and forgot some [[spectacles]] on the bar &mdash; without a coaster, to Hurrwarr's chagrin.
